metadata_system.name: NTFS Alternate Data Streams
metadata_system.used_for: Hidden Windows file streams attached via the colon syntax
metadata_system.spec_source: Microsoft NTFS specification; MS-FSCC §2.4.7; MITRE T1564.004
metadata_system.description: NTFS supports multiple named data streams per file via the syntax 'file.txt:streamname'. The most famous is Zone.Identifier — set by browsers/apps to mark internet-downloaded files and trigger SmartScreen / Office Protected View. Streams are invisible to most tools (they don't change file size or hash of the default stream). Forensically valuable for tracing file origins; abused by malware for hidden payload storage.
